examples.title: Basic callout
examples.description: Inline aside next to body content. With no variant it is the quiet neutral note.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Callout } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<Callout title="Note">
  This setting applies to all projects in your organization and cannot be overridden per-project.
</Callout>

examples.title: Neutral note with an action
examples.description: A plain note that explains a state, with an icon and one link under the message.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Callout, Link } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import { Info } from '@lucide/svelte';
</script>

<Callout variant="neutral" semantic="note">
  {#snippet icon()}
    <Info size={16} />
  {/snippet}
  Gave up after 5 attempts. The check was never met.
  {#snippet action()}
    <Link href="/goals/draft-release-notes/attempts/5">Open attempt 5</Link>
  {/snippet}
</Callout>
